question: Onam is a state festival of_______
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Onam** is a festival celebrated in the state of **Kerala**, which is located in the **southern part** of India.
 
• It is one of the most important festivals in Kerala and is celebrated with** great enthusiasm and joy** by people of all religions and communities.
 
• The festival is celebrated to commemorate the homecoming of** King Mahabali**, who is believed to have ruled Kerala in ancient times.
 
• The festival is celebrated over a period of **10 days** and is marked by various cultural events, traditional feasts, and colorful decorations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gujarat **is known for the **Navratri festival, Modhera Dance Festival, Bhavnath Mahadev Fair and Rann Utsav.**
 
• **Karnataka** is known for the** Dasara festival, Ugadi, and Tula Sankramana.**
 
• **Goa** is known for the **Carnival festival and Potekar.**
